declarations.name: AuiTransferList
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI TransferList: `<aui-transfer-list>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label of the control; names the group.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text, referenced by the group.

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: All items { value, label, description?, disabled? }; values are unique.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name: one hidden input per selected value.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: At least one item must be selected.

inputs.name: minSelected
inputs.description: At least this many items when any are selected (or when required).

inputs.name: maxSelected
inputs.description: Hard limit; moves beyond it are refused and announced.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Lists can be browsed and searched, but nothing moves.

inputs.name: searchable
inputs.description: Show a search box above each list.

inputs.name: draggable
inputs.description: Drag items between the lists with a pointer.

inputs.name: titles
inputs.type: { readonly available?: string; readonly selected?: string; }

inputs.name: visibleRows
inputs.description: Rows visible in each list before it scrolls (3 to 50).

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the value invalid.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of counts, messages, and search matching.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: Items moved: { value, validity, moved, to }.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: Show or clear an external error.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear searches, checks, and messages.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Listbox (multi-select, recommended selection model): each list is role=listbox with aria-multiselectable; focus stays on the listbox and aria-activedescendant names the active option; aria-selected marks checked options.

limitations: Rows have a fixed height so the window can be computed; long labels and descriptions are truncated with an ellipsis.
Values not found in items are dropped from the value.
The Selected list cannot be reordered.
